title: Offline PWA Support, Precached Navigation & Instant Settings Sync
summary: Introduces full offline PWA capabilities with comprehensive static bundle and RSC stream pre-caching, smooth offline navigation for inventory and database sections, Web Share Target integration, and synchronous local settings hydration.

changes.text: Full offline PWA support: service worker automatically precaches application pages, extracted Next.js static script and stylesheet chunks, and RSC flight streams on install.
Web Share Target API: allows sharing screenshots and video files directly into the scanner from mobile browsers and system share sheets.
Synchronous settings hydration: sync settings load instantly from local storage during initial layout hydration, eliminating layout shifts and race conditions on startup.

Offline inventory and database navigation: ShellLink gracefully transitions to native document navigation offline, while the service worker intercepts RSC flight requests and navigation aliases to prevent client exceptions.
Database detail modal images: ensures material, weapon, and character thumbnails in database sheets resolve reliably in both online and offline contexts.
